'''August 2004 Syracuse tournament''' was a sanctioned Star Wars CCG tournament held on 28 August 2004 at the N. Clinton St. Altered States in Syracuse, New York, run by [[Steve Jones]]. The entry fee was six dollars, and the tournament was listed on Decipher's site.<ref name="pcf-3915-53388">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=53388#53388 Syracuse Tounament 8/28/04], Andrew Shuman, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (27 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041210031818/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=53388%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
